disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码、构建产物与配置中是否出现 API 密钥、令牌、私钥、云凭据等敏感字样，未检出硬编码凭据。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code, build artifacts, and configuration for sensitive strings such as API keys, tokens, private keys, and cloud credentials; no hardcoded credentials detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码对用户主目录凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云配置等敏感位置的读取行为，未检出；插件唯一的文件读取是打包在自身目录里的 24 张皮肤图片。
checked_items.en: Checked code for reading of sensitive locations such as user home directory credential files, SSH private keys, and cloud configuration; none detected. The plugin's only file reads are 24 skin images bundled in its own directory.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取任何系统或用户凭据文件，也无可外发数据的网络通道，凭据外泄路径不成立。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read any system or user credential files and has no network channel for data exfiltration; the credential exfiltration path does not exist.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否注册工具或注入系统提示词片段：插件是纯界面皮肤，不注册任何工具，也没有向模型请求面写入文本的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin registers tools or injects system prompt fragments: the plugin is a pure UI skin, registers no tools, and contains no code that writes text to the model request surface.

checked_items.zh: 通读 README 与界面文案，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息等注入措辞；README 中的安装提示是面向用户的安装文档，不会进入模型上下文。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the README and interface copy; no injection-style wording such as instruction override or disguised system messages found. The install instructions in the README are user-facing installation documentation and do not enter the model context.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，没有工具描述进入模型请求，投毒面不存在。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so no tool descriptions enter model requests; the poisoning surface does not exist.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册工具，无工具描述可诱导模型执行安装或改配置行为；README 安装说明属用户文档。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so no tool descriptions could induce the model to perform installations or configuration changes; the README installation instructions are user documentation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml：仅含一条加载器条目插入，无动态脚本标量，无执行面。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config cordis.patch.yml: it contains only one loader entry insertion, with no dynamic script scalars and no execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查全部代码与构建脚本：未检出 eval、动态函数、子进程、命令执行等调用；package.json 无安装钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked all code and build scripts: no eval, dynamic functions, subprocesses, or command execution calls detected; package.json has no install hooks.

checked_items.zh: 对构建产物 lib/client.js 与 lib/client.js.map 的机器预扫命中逐条复核（规则 DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60）：三处命中均为 esbuild 构建输出的正常形态——中文文案转义为 Unicode 序列（如“发送消息”按钮选择器）以及 source map 内嵌源码的单行 JSON，与 src/client/ 可读源码一一对应，非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Reviewed each machine pre-scan hit in the build artifacts lib/client.js and lib/client.js.map (rules DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60): all three hits are normal esbuild build output—Chinese text escaped as Unicode sequences (e.g., the "send message" button selector) and single-line JSON with embedded source maps—corresponding one-to-one to the readable source in src/client/, not obfuscated code.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入一条加载器声明，无动态脚本执行标量，不存在配置即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts one loader declaration, with no dynamic script execution scalar; there is no configuration-as-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 代码未调用动态包执行工具，也没有 eval 或 node:vm 求值面。
evidence.en: The code does not invoke dynamic package execution tools and has no eval or node:vm evaluation surface.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装/准备钩子，源码树无钩子脚本或 CI 执行载体；构建仅用 esbuild 本地打包。
evidence.en: package.json has no install/prepare hooks, and the source tree contains no hook scripts or CI execution carriers; the build only uses local esbuild bundling.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器客户端，客户端代码逐行核对：无全局键盘监听、无剪贴板读取、无特权接口调用，仅加载同源皮肤图片并注入界面控件。
evidence.en: Declares a browser client; client code reviewed line by line: no global keyboard listeners, no clipboard reads, no privileged interface calls—it only loads same-origin skin images and injects UI controls.

checked_items.zh: 检查全部运行时代码的网络调用面（fetch、XHR、WebSocket、外部 URL）：未检出任何外发请求；浏览器端仅加载同源图片，服务端只响应自身打包图片的固定清单。
checked_items.en: Checked the network call surface of all runtime code (fetch, XHR, WebSocket, external URLs): no outbound requests detected; the browser side only loads same-origin images, and the server only responds with a fixed list of its own bundled images.

checked_items.zh: 未检出编码外发、隧道、端点劫持等外泄通道，无新增外联域名。
checked_items.en: No exfiltration channels such as encoded exfiltration, tunneling, or endpoint hijacking detected; no new outbound domains.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取、无外联代码路径，凭据外泄通道的两条腿都不存在。
evidence.en: No credential reads and no outbound code paths; both legs of the credential exfiltration channel are absent.

checked_items.zh: 检查依赖声明与锁文件：运行时零依赖，开发依赖仅 esbuild、vitest 与类型声明且版本锁定；无安装钩子、无远程脚本即执行。
checked_items.en: Checked dependency declarations and lock file: zero runtime dependencies, dev dependencies only esbuild, vitest, and type declarations with pinned versions; no install hooks, no remote-script-execution.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置是否触碰安全配置行：仅新增一条加载器条目，无禁用安全项、无环境变量降权、无注入/拦截改写。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch config touches security configuration lines: only adds one loader entry, with no disabled security items, no permission-downscaling environment variables, and no injection/interception rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法做升级对比；插件名与仓库名一致，未见仿冒或依赖混淆迹象。
checked_items.en: First-time audit has no version baseline, so no upgrade comparison possible; plugin name matches the repository name, with no signs of impersonation or dependency confusion.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只新增加载器条目，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch config only adds a loader entry and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听审批或工具执行类安全事件，不存在截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to security events such as approval or tool execution, so there is no code to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计没有基线版本可对比，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: First-time audit has no baseline version to compare, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务的篡改。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception settings, so there is no tampering that adds required services for security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动网络服务或监听端口：未检出；插件仅在宿主 Web 服务上注册自身打包图片的静态路由。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own network service or listens on ports: none detected; the plugin only registers a static route for its own bundled images on the host web service.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未运行，未做运行时行为观测；宿主“本机无认证 RPC”属生态固有风险，本插件未新增此类暴露面。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox was not run, so no runtime behavior observation was performed; the host's "no-auth local RPC" is an inherent ecosystem risk, and this plugin does not add such exposure.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动独立网络服务，仅复用宿主静态资源路由；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主固有风险，与本插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a separate network service and only reuses the host's static resource routes; no-auth local RPC is an inherent host risk unrelated to this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件身份与清单核对通过：dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client 声明齐全，包名与仓库一致，无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Plugin identity and manifest checked: dsh.bundle and dsh.client declarations are complete, package name matches the repository, and no impersonation signs found.

summary.zh: 静态规则扫描通过：配置无动态脚本标量，无执行类函数调用；构建产物三处密度命中逐条复核后确认均为构建输出正常形态（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 排除）。
summary.en: Static rule scan passed: no dynamic script scalars in the config, no execution-type function calls; the three density hits in build artifacts were manually reviewed and confirmed as normal build output (excluded by rules DSH-X08/DG-R3-60).

summary.zh: 行为面分析通过：无安装钩子、无凭据读取、无混淆载荷、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis passed: no install hooks, no credential reads, no obfuscated payloads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: 元数据语义审查通过：插件不注册工具、不注入系统提示词，无可投毒面。
summary.en: Metadata semantic review passed: the plugin does not register tools or inject system prompts, leaving no poisoning surface.
Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 未启用）；首次审计无版本基线；插件清单未显式声明能力，network/shell/fs/modelFacing 按代码实测推断；构建产物 lib/client.js 与 lib/client.js.map 已与 src/client/ 可读源码逐项对照，无隐藏代码。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed (DG-L4 not enabled); first-time audit has no version baseline; the plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capabilities, with network/shell/fs/modelFacing inferred from code inspection; build artifacts lib/client.js and lib/client.js.map were cross-checked against readable source in src/client/, with no hidden code.
